card.name: Words just before symptom descriptions
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation (an, a, the, a comma, e.g.) that come right before a named symptom or sign of infection, such as rash, fever, or relapse.

modes.label: Article before symptom
modes.description: A, an or the sits right before a symptom such as rash or relapse.
modes.example: present with<< an>> atypical MS relapse or multiorgan

modes.label: Comma in symptom list
modes.description: A comma or e.g. opens or continues a list of symptoms of an infection.
modes.example: acute HIV-1 infection (e.g., fever<<,>> fatigue, myalgia, skin rash

modes.label: Before disease stage or name
modes.description: A space or partial word comes just before a disease stage or illness name.
